reasoning: As of October 16, 2025, Trump has won the election (he took office in January 2025). The question asks if inflation will be below 2.5% in 2025. Evidence shows: (1) Inflation averaged 2.65% Jan-Aug 2025, peaked at 2.9% in August, and has been reaccelerating due to tariffs; (2) Multiple sources confirm inflation is above 2.5% and rising, not falling; (3) Tariffs are adding ~2.3% to inflation; (4) Goldman Sachs projects tariff pass-through will increase from 22% to 67%, worsening inflation; (5) Core inflation reached 3.1% in August; (6) Food and energy prices are rising. The trajectory shows inflation moving away from the 2.5% threshold rather than toward it. With only ~2.5 months remaining in 2025 and current inflation at 2.9%+, achieving a full-year average below 2.5% appears highly unlikely.
